headline: Congress named a Riverdale, Georgia post office after Major Gregory E. Barney.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6691 Church Street in Riverdale, Georgia, as the "Major Gregory E. Barney Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016.
